cases.question: The box says water detected. What should I do?

good.answer: Review it now. Read the reason and time, try the linked contact if consent is recorded, and send the water message. If anyone is in danger tell them to call 911. Do not say the home is flooded or safe.

bad.answer: The house is flooded and a crew has been sent.
Water was reported so the home is safe to enter once it dries.

cases.question: A box has been quiet for 30 minutes. Can I assume the family left?

good.answer: I cannot say whether anyone left. A silent box is unknown, not safe, and offline alone is never critical. Check whether neighbors are also silent and try the household contact.

bad.answer: Nobody is home so you can skip it.

cases.question: Mains power is off on one box and the battery is fine. What do I do?

good.answer: Watch it. The box keeps recording on backup. Check whether nearby boxes report the same before calling it an outage, and do not state battery life without a bench measurement.

bad.answer: The whole street is out and battery will last 40 hours.

cases.question: Eight boxes in one area went quiet at the same time. What does that mean?

good.answer: The area summary reports a possible grid or internet outage. Review the area, check mains reports from neighbors that still report, and send one regional information message. Do not dispatch from this alone. Offline boxes are unknown, not damaged.

bad.answer: They are all damaged and responders are on the way.

cases.question: A household pressed the help button. Can I tell them help is on the way?
pack: only when a person actually does that

good.answer: Not yet. Set the help status to review queued and tell them the request is being reviewed. Say help is on the way only after a person has arranged it.

bad.answer: Yes, help is on the way.

cases.question: Investigate the water signal on this box and save a checkpoint.

good.summary: The box reported water at the sensor and mains power loss within minutes of each other. These are observations; co-occurrence does not prove cause.
